confidence_notes: Beer, coffee and meal anchors come from crowd-sourced and travel-site aggregates (Numbeo, Citycost, PO Cruises, expat guides) that disagree and are not dated surveys, so they are medium quality. Cocktail and wine_glass have no Nafplio-specific figure: they are inferred from the beer anchor and from general Greek city and club bar ranges, which is a low-confidence basis. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season from general knowledge and the city context; no booking pages or listings were inspected. The EUR to USD conversion uses an assumed rate of about 1.15 from general knowledge, not a sourced rate. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure I could read (20 March 2026), not verified as the latest available on 2026-10-16, so it may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Nafplio is a mid-sized Peloponnese tourist town. Restaurant and drink prices are benchmarked against the Numbeo, Citycost and PO Cruises figures for Nafplio and against Greek mainland tourist-town and Athens price points, with island and Athens prices treated as upper bounds. Cocktail is set at about 2.4 times the beer anchor, and wine_glass at about 1.25 times it, consistent with the Greek city bar range. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a Greek mainland tourist town in July.
